c.seed: arts and humanities nonfiction — Kabuki theater stylization and masculine onnagata performance tradition challenging gender representation in Japanese dramatic arts

g.passage: In Kabuki theater, the onnagata, male actors who specialize in female roles, do not attempt to imitate women realistically. Instead, the stylized gestures, lowered gaze, and carefully controlled falsetto that an onnagata spends decades refining under a senior performer ______ an idealized femininity that exists only on the stage, prompting scholars to argue that the tradition treats gender as a learned artistic form rather than a natural fact.
g.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
g.explanation: 이 문장의 주어는 복수형 "the stylized gestures, lowered gaze, and carefully controlled falsetto"이고, "that an onnagata spends ... performer"는 주어를 꾸미는 관계절일 뿐이다. 따라서 문장에는 복수 주어와 일치하는 정동사가 필요하므로 A의 "construct"가 정답이다. B는 정동사이긴 하지만, 바로 앞의 단수 명사 "onnagata"나 "performer"에 수를 맞춘 단수형이어서 복수 주어와 일치하지 않는다. C와 D는 각각 현재분사와 완료분사여서 문장에 정동사가 없게 되므로 문장이 성립하지 않는다.
g.explanation_en: The subject of this sentence is the plural "the stylized gestures, lowered gaze, and carefully controlled falsetto." The clause "that an onnagata spends ... performer" just modifies that subject. So the sentence needs a main verb that agrees with a plural subject, which makes A, "construct," correct. B is a main verb, but it is singular, as if it agreed with the nearby singular nouns "onnagata" or "performer," so it doesn't match the plural subject. C and D are a present participle and a perfect participle, so with either one the sentence would have no main verb and would be incomplete.
g.design: 하나의 주어를 여러 명사로 길게 나열하고 그 뒤에 단수 명사가 들어간 관계절을 넣어 수 일치를 헷갈리게 했다. 학생은 먼저 정동사가 필요한지 판단하고, 다음으로 어떤 수에 맞춰야 하는지 판단해야 하므로 두 단계 판단이 필요하다.

g.passage: Before the invention of the staff, the neumes that scribes in medieval European monasteries wrote above the words of Gregorian chant could not by themselves tell a singer which exact pitches to sing. Instead, these small strokes and hooks reminded cantors of the general shape of a melody they had already memorized, so the survival of the chant repertoire across many generations, despite the limits of the notation, ______ on years of oral instruction from master to novice.
g.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
g.explanation: "so" 뒤의 절은 주어 "the survival"(단수)을 가지며, 이 절에는 정동사가 필요하다. B "depended"는 단수 주어와 맞는 과거시제 정동사라서 절을 완성한다. A "having depended"와 D "to depend"는 각각 분사와 부정사여서 정동사 역할을 할 수 없으므로 절이 완성되지 않는다. C "were depending"은 정동사이긴 하지만 복수형이어서, 바로 앞의 복수 명사 "generations"나 "the limits of the notation"에 이끌려 일치시킨 오류다.
g.explanation_en: The clause after "so" has the singular subject "the survival," and that clause needs a finite main verb. B, "depended," is a past-tense finite verb that agrees with a singular subject, so it completes the clause. A ("having depended") is a participle and D ("to depend") is an infinitive, and neither one can work as the main verb, so the clause stays incomplete. C ("were depending") is a finite verb, but it's plural. It wrongly agrees with nearby plural nouns like "generations" or "limits" instead of the real subject, "survival."
g.design: 긴 수식어구와 삽입구가 주어와 동사 사이에 끼어 있어, 정동사 여부와 주어-동사 일치를 둘 다 확인해야 하는 두 단계 판단 문제다. 오답 C는 정동사 조건은 만족해서 부분적으로 그럴듯하다.

g.passage: After the 1917 revolution, the Russian Constructivists rejected representational painting as a relic of bourgeois taste and turned instead to geometric abstraction and industrial design, which they saw as better suited to a socialist society. Aleksandr Rodchenko's 1921 triptych of monochrome canvases, each painted in a single primary color, ______ often cited by historians as the moment the movement declared the end of easel painting.
g.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
g.explanation: 이 문장의 주어는 단수 명사 'triptych'이고, 'of monochrome canvases'와 삽입구 'each painted in a single primary color'는 주어를 꾸미는 수식어일 뿐이다. 따라서 문장에는 단수 주어와 일치하는 정동사가 필요하므로 C 'is'가 정답이다. A와 D는 정동사라서 문장을 완성하지만, 가까이 있는 복수 명사 'canvases'에 맞춘 복수형이어서 주어와 수가 일치하지 않는다. B 'being'은 분사라서 문장에 정동사가 없게 되어 불완전한 문장이 된다.
g.explanation_en: The subject of this sentence is the singular noun "triptych." The phrase "of monochrome canvases" and the interrupting phrase "each painted in a single primary color" only modify that subject. So the sentence needs a main verb that agrees with a singular subject, which makes C, "is," the correct answer. A and D are main verbs, so they would complete the sentence, but they are plural forms that match the nearby noun "canvases" instead of the actual subject. B, "being," is a participle, so it leaves the sentence without a main verb and makes it incomplete.
g.design: 단수 주어와 동사 사이에 복수 명사가 든 전치사구와 삽입구를 넣었다. 그래서 주어를 찾고(구조 파악) 수를 맞추는(규칙 적용) 두 단계 판단이 필요하다. A와 D는 정동사라는 점에서는 부분적으로 맞지만 복수형이라 틀린 선택지다.

g.passage: In classical Japanese haiku, the kigo, a seasonal word such as "frog" for spring or "harvest moon" for autumn that poets selected from carefully compiled almanacs known as saijiki, ______ the poem's brief seventeen syllables to a specific moment in the turning year, allowing a few images to evoke an entire landscape.
g.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
g.explanation: 이 문장의 주어는 단수 명사 "the kigo"이며, 동격어구와 관계절이 끼어 있어 주어와 동사가 멀리 떨어져 있습니다. 따라서 빈칸에는 단수 주어와 일치하는 정동사가 필요하므로 D "anchors"가 정답입니다. A "anchor"는 정동사이긴 하지만 바로 앞의 복수 명사 "almanacs"나 "saijiki"에 맞춘 복수형이라 주어와 일치하지 않습니다. B "anchoring"과 C "having anchored"는 분사이므로 주절에 정동사가 없어 완전한 문장이 되지 않습니다.
g.explanation_en: The subject of this sentence is the singular noun "the kigo," but an appositive phrase and a relative clause come between it and the blank. The blank needs a finite verb that agrees with that singular subject, so D, "anchors," is correct. A, "anchor," is a finite verb, but it's plural, as if it agreed with the nearby nouns "almanacs" or "saijiki," so it doesn't agree with the real subject. B, "anchoring," and C, "having anchored," are participles, which would leave the main clause without a finite verb and make the sentence incomplete.
g.design: 긴 동격어구와 관계절로 주어와 동사를 떼어 놓고, 바로 앞의 복수 명사로 수 일치를 헷갈리게 만들었습니다. 오답에는 정동사와 비정동사(분사)가 섞여 있어서, 정동사가 필요한지와 수 일치가 맞는지를 두 단계로 판단해야 합니다.

c.seed: arts and humanities nonfiction — Art Deco design movement and machine-age ornamentation in twentieth-century decorative arts and architectural facade styling

g.passage: In the 1920s and 1930s, Art Deco designers borrowed the visual language of the machine age. The stylized sunbursts, chevrons, and stepped zigzags that decorated the terra-cotta panels of New York's Chanin Building, a skyscraper whose bronze-trimmed facade still draws admiring architects, ______ meant to evoke the speed and precision of turbines, automobiles, and ocean liners.
g.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
g.explanation: 이 문장의 주어는 복수형인 "The stylized sunbursts, chevrons, and stepped zigzags"이고, 그 뒤의 관계절과 동격어구는 수식어일 뿐이다. 따라서 문장에는 복수 정동사가 필요하며 과거 시대를 말하므로 A "were"가 맞다. B "was"는 시제는 맞지만 빈칸 바로 앞의 단수 명사 "facade"나 "Building"에 수를 맞춘 것이어서 주어와 일치하지 않는다. C "having been"과 D "being"은 분사여서 정동사 역할을 할 수 없고, 문장에 주절 동사가 없는 불완전한 문장을 만든다.
g.explanation_en: The subject of this sentence is the plural "The stylized sunbursts, chevrons, and stepped zigzags." The relative clause and the appositive that follow it are only modifiers. That means the sentence needs a plural finite verb, and since it describes the past, A ("were") is correct. B ("was") has the right tense, but it's singular, so it agrees with the nearby noun "facade" or "Building" instead of the real subject. C ("having been") and D ("being") are participles, which can't act as the main verb, so either one would leave the sentence without a main verb.
g.design: A long modifier ending in a singular noun separates the plural subject from the blank. This sets a trap where readers who skim match the verb to the nearby singular noun. To rule out the wrong answers, students have to find the subject and also recognize that the sentence needs a finite verb.

g.passage: In Noh theater, a mask's expression is fixed in wood, yet audiences perceive it changing throughout a performance. The subtly asymmetrical features of a single mask, carved over many weeks by an artisan who pares Japanese cypress in strokes finer than a sheet of paper, ______ an actor to suggest sorrow by tilting the head slightly downward and delight by lifting it toward the light.
g.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
g.explanation: 이 문장의 주어는 'features'(복수)이고, 'of a single mask'와 'carved over ... paper' 구는 주어를 꾸미는 수식어일 뿐이므로 빈칸에는 복수 주어에 맞는 정동사가 와야 한다. 따라서 B 'allow'가 정답이다. A 'allows'는 정동사라는 점은 맞지만 바로 앞의 단수 명사 mask, artisan, cypress에 수를 맞춘 것이어서 복수 주어와 일치하지 않는다. C 'allowing'과 D 'having allowed'는 분사형이어서 문장에 정동사가 없게 되고, 결국 완전한 문장이 되지 못한다.
g.explanation_en: The subject of this sentence is the plural noun "features." The phrases "of a single mask" and "carved over ... paper" only modify that subject, so the blank needs a finite verb that agrees with a plural subject. That makes B, "allow," the answer. A, "allows," is a finite verb, but it's singular, so it agrees with nearby nouns like "mask," "artisan," or "cypress" instead of the real subject. C, "allowing," and D, "having allowed," are participles, so they'd leave the sentence without a main verb, and it wouldn't be a complete sentence.
g.design: This item tests subject-verb agreement when a long modifier sits between the subject and the blank. Two choices are participles, so you first have to see that the sentence needs a finite verb. Then you have to find the real subject so you don't pick the singular verb that matches the closer nouns.

g.passage: In James Joyce's Ulysses (1922), the interior monologues of characters such as Leopold Bloom rarely move in a straight line from past to present. A passing smell of kidneys frying, a glimpse of a stranger's hat, or a half-remembered song ______ Bloom's thoughts backward by years in the space of a single sentence, so that the novel's chronology seems to fracture under the pressure of memory.
g.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
g.explanation: 이 문장의 주어는 'or'로 연결된 세 명사구이고, 그 뒤에 정동사가 필요하다. C 'can send'는 조동사+동사원형이라 수 일치 문제 없이 정동사 역할을 하므로 정답이다. A 'sends'는 정동사이긴 하지만, 'or'로 이어진 주어는 가장 가까운 명사('a half-remembered song')에 동사를 맞추므로 단수 동사가 맞아 보일 수 있다. 그러나 이 문장은 여러 계기가 일반적으로 일으키는 일을 묘사하므로… 사실 A도 문법적으로 성립 가능해 보이지만, 이 문항에서는 'can'이 들어가야 'so that' 결과절과 함께 습관적 가능성의 의미가 완성된다는 점에서 C가 가장 적절하다. B 'sending'과 D 'having sent'는 분사라서 문장에 정동사가 없게 만든다.
g.explanation_en: The subject here is three noun phrases joined by "or," and the sentence still needs a main verb after them. C, "can send," is a modal plus a base verb, so it works as a finite verb and avoids any subject-verb agreement problem, which makes it the answer. A, "sends," is also a finite verb, and it could look acceptable because a subject joined by "or" agrees with the nearest noun ("a half-remembered song"). Still, C fits best: "can" signals what these triggers are able to do in general, which matches the "so that" clause and the word "rarely" earlier in the passage. B, "sending," and D, "having sent," are participles, so with either one the sentence would have no main verb.
g.design: The answer requires two steps: first see that the long compound subject still needs a main verb, then compare the finite choices. The participle choices are traps for students who skim.

- 세부 기술 힌트: 긴 수식어구/도치 뒤의 주어-동사 일치, 병렬 구조, 수식어 위치(dangling modifier), 정동사 vs 분사/부정사 선택처럼 구조 파악이 필요한 문제.
c.seed: arts and humanities nonfiction — Islamic geometric pattern tessellation and arabesque ornamentation expressing mathematical principles in mosque architectural decoration

g.passage: In many medieval mosques, ornament served as a kind of visual mathematics. The interlocking star-and-polygon patterns that cover the tiled walls of Isfahan's Friday Mosque, each one generated from a single circle divided into equal segments with only a compass and straightedge, ______ on a small set of repeating units that can, in principle, extend across a surface without gaps or overlaps.
g.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
g.explanation: 이 문장의 주어는 복수 명사 'patterns'이며, 'that cover…'와 'each one generated…straightedge'는 주어와 동사 사이에 끼어든 수식어구이다. 따라서 빈칸에는 복수 주어와 일치하는 정동사가 필요하므로 D의 'rely'가 정답이다. A는 정동사이지만 바로 앞의 단수 명사 'circle'이나 'each one'에 이끌린 단수형이라 주어와 맞지 않는다. B 역시 단수형이며, 진행형은 일반적인 특성을 서술하는 문맥에도 어울리지 않는다. C는 분사라서 문장에 본동사가 없게 되어 불완전한 문장이 된다.
g.explanation_en: The subject of this sentence is the plural noun "patterns." Both "that cover…" and "each one generated…straightedge" are modifiers that come between the subject and the verb. So the blank needs a main verb that agrees with a plural subject, which makes D, "rely," correct. A is a main verb, but it's singular, probably because the nearby singular words "circle" or "each one" pull you toward it, so it doesn't agree with "patterns." B is also singular, and the progressive form doesn't fit a sentence describing a general, lasting feature. C is a participle, so with it the sentence has no main verb and becomes a fragment.
g.design: A long relative clause plus an absolute phrase with singular nouns ("each one," "circle") separates the plural subject from the blank. The student has to find the real subject and also see that the sentence needs a main verb.

c.instruction:
- easy: 한 가지 명시적 개념·규칙만으로 푼다. 단서가 지문에 직접 드러나고 추론은 한 단계 이하이다. 어휘·문장은 평이하다. 오답 3개는 해당 규칙을 알면 바로 배제되지만 규칙을 모르는 학생에게는 그럴듯해 보이는 전형적 오개념이어야 한다(말도 안 되는 선택지 금지).
- 세부 기술 힌트: 수식어가 짧은 주어-동사 수 일치, 시제 일관성, 대명사 격/수 일치처럼 한 규칙을 묻는 문제.
c.seed: arts and humanities nonfiction — Commedia dell'arte stock characters and improvisation techniques influencing European theater comedic conventions Renaissance onwards

g.passage: Developed in sixteenth-century Italy, commedia dell'arte relied on performers who improvised dialogue around a simple plot outline. The stock characters of this tradition, such as the clever servant Arlecchino, ______ familiar to audiences of European comedy today, appearing in works ranging from Molière's plays to modern television sitcoms.
g.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
g.explanation: 이 문장의 주어는 복수 명사 "The stock characters"이므로 복수 동사가 필요하다. A의 "remain"은 복수 주어와 일치하고, 지문 전체의 현재 시제("today")와도 맞는다. B, C, D는 모두 단수 동사 형태(remains, has, is)로, 주어 바로 뒤의 단수 명사 "tradition"이나 "Arlecchino"에 이끌린 오답이다. 따라서 정답은 A이다.
g.explanation_en: The subject of this sentence is the plural noun "The stock characters," so you need a plural verb. Choice A, "remain," agrees with that plural subject and matches the present tense of the passage ("today"). Choices B, C, and D all use singular verb forms (remains, has, is). They may look right if you match the verb to a singular noun that sits closer to the blank, like "tradition" or "Arlecchino." So the correct answer is A.
g.design: 하나의 규칙(주어-동사 수 일치)만 묻고, 짧은 수식어구가 단수 명사를 끼워 넣어 전형적 오개념을 유도한다.

c.seed: arts and humanities nonfiction — Gothic Revival architecture and medieval aesthetic nostalgia inspiring nineteenth-century European church and civic building design

g.passage: During the nineteenth century, many European architects turned to the Middle Ages for inspiration, a style now known as Gothic Revival. The Houses of Parliament in London, rebuilt after a fire in 1834, ______ pointed arches, tall towers, and detailed stone carvings modeled on medieval cathedrals.
g.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
g.explanation: 이 문장의 주어는 복수 명사 'The Houses (of Parliament)'이므로 복수 동사가 필요하다. 'rebuilt after a fire in 1834'는 주어와 동사 사이에 끼어든 수식어일 뿐 수 일치에 영향을 주지 않는다. 따라서 복수 동사 B가 정답이다. A, C, D는 모두 단수 주어에 맞는 형태라서 바로 앞의 'Parliament'나 '1834'를 주어로 착각할 때 고르기 쉽지만, 복수 주어와 수가 맞지 않는다.
g.explanation_en: The subject of this sentence is the plural noun "The Houses (of Parliament)," so it needs a plural verb. The phrase "rebuilt after a fire in 1834" is just a modifier between the subject and the verb, and it doesn't change agreement. That makes B, the plural verb, correct. A, C, and D are all singular forms. They can look right if you mistake "Parliament" or "1834" for the subject, but they don't agree with the plural subject.
g.design: 짧은 삽입 수식어가 있는 복수 주어–동사 수 일치 한 가지 규칙만 묻도록 하고, 오답은 모두 단수 형태로 구성했다.

c.seed: arts and humanities nonfiction — African diaspora call-and-response singing tradition and antiphonal structure shaping American blues spiritual and work song genres

g.passage: Many scholars trace American blues, spirituals, and work songs to call-and-response singing traditions carried across the Atlantic by enslaved Africans. In this antiphonal form, one voice sings a line and a group answers it. The basic structure of these songs ______ a leader's call with a chorus's reply, a pattern that helped workers keep a shared rhythm during long hours of labor.
g.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
g.design: 수식어 "of these songs"가 짧게 끼어든 단수 주어 "structure"와의 주어-동사 수 일치 하나만 묻는다. 오답은 모두 가까운 복수 명사 "songs"에 맞춘 복수형이다.
g.explanation: 문장의 주어는 "songs"가 아니라 단수 명사 "structure"이므로 단수 동사가 필요하다. C의 "pairs"는 단수 주어와 일치하고 지문의 현재 시제와도 맞는다. A "pair"는 복수형 동사로 바로 앞의 "songs"에 잘못 맞춘 것이다. B "have paired"와 D "are pairing"도 복수 주어에 쓰는 형태이므로 단수 주어 "structure"와 맞지 않는다.
g.explanation_en: The subject of this sentence is the singular noun "structure," not "songs," so you need a singular verb. Choice C, "pairs," agrees with that singular subject and fits the passage's present tense. Choice A, "pair," is a plural verb, which matches the nearby noun "songs" by mistake. Choices B, "have paired," and D, "are pairing," are also plural forms, so they don't agree with "structure" either.

c.seed: arts and humanities nonfiction — Dadaism absurdist anti-art movement and chance procedures rejecting rational meaning during World War One cultural crisis

g.passage: During World War One, a group of artists and writers gathered in Zurich and launched Dadaism, a movement that mocked the idea that art must make rational sense. Poet Tristan Tzara, for example, created poems by cutting words from newspapers and drawing them randomly from a bag. Such chance procedures, which deliberately removed the artist's control, ______ the Dadaists' belief that the logic of European society had collapsed along with its peace.
g.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
g.explanation: 이 문장의 주어는 복수형 "chance procedures"이므로 동사도 복수 주어와 맞아야 한다. 'which deliberately removed the artist's control'은 삽입된 수식어일 뿐 주어의 수를 바꾸지 않는다. D의 "reflected"는 과거 시제라 복수 주어와 함께 쓸 수 있고, 지문의 과거 서술(gathered, launched, created)과도 맞는다. A "reflects"와 C "has reflected"는 단수 동사이고, B "was reflecting"도 단수형 was를 쓰므로 복수 주어와 수가 일치하지 않는다.
g.explanation_en: The subject of this sentence is the plural noun "chance procedures," so the verb has to agree with a plural subject. The clause "which deliberately removed the artist's control" just adds description and doesn't change the subject's number. D, "reflected," is a past-tense verb that works with a plural subject, and it matches the passage's past-tense narration (gathered, launched, created). A ("reflects") and C ("has reflected") are singular verbs, and B uses the singular "was," so none of them agree with the plural subject.
g.design: 수식절이 짧게 끼어든 복수 주어-동사 수 일치라는 한 규칙만 묻는다. 오답은 모두 단수 동사형이고, 학생이 단수 명사 "control"에 끌려 고르기 쉽게 만들었다.
